<!-- nativecmpkit-resolution:UI-003:20261028-compact-important-direct -->
All three original acceptance criteria reviewed and satisfied. **Closing directly after important tests/source/result review**, with documentation afterward.

Fresh [actual iOS application run40757579707](https://github.com/Apdelrahman1911/nativeCmpkit/actions/runs/40757579707), immutable79861d7c: **1/1 compact-disabled replacement**, one fresh XML, zero failures/errors/skips; Gradle0/1339.23s. All808 own-Git inputs and dispatch/runner maps held, JDK17, application protocol/XML agreement and owned Worker/application cleanup verified.

The genuine compact container preserves configured visible background/tint and exact system-control geometry. Both initial and equal-valued replacement inspect real child min/max/date, disabled input/interaction, explicit semantic/effective RTL, dark theme/tint and actual child ownership. Old container/child detach; ordinary recompositions before/after replacement retain exact object identity. No mocked getter, private UIKit mutation or relaxed failed assertion. Raw system-control diagnostics explain the earlier null background; the child needs its own trait setters.

**Reused, not rerun:** two accepted actual inline/range replacement methods from40716564702/71b19242. Calendar/range owning implementations are byte-identical; reviewed shared manager delegation/default layout setter performs the same operation on the same calendar view. Test helper changes are compact-only; no blanket whole-file identity claim. Original failed workflows40716564702/40733683010/40744297959 remain preserved.

Evidence follows under `docs/development/evidence/compact-native-important-20261028/`. This closes UI-003, not physical/minimum-OS/accessibility/heap/ABI/consumer/dependency/legal/security or release gates. Public Calf signatures/history/attribution retained. No packages/releases/deployments.
